description: This file contains platform-specific functions for checking and upgrading the firmware image on a device running OpenWrt, including a placeholder for board-specific upgrade logic.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function to verify the firmware image, currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Function to perform the firmware upgrade, defaulting to a generic upgrade method unless overridden by a specific board.
